tensions.name: Asset-Light Marketplace vs 1P Inventory Ownership

side_a.position: 1P inventory ownership is required to guarantee fulfillment OTIF and capture gross margin.
side_a.evidence: Wasoko and MaxAB argued that only owned warehouses ensure delivery reliability in volatile markets.

side_b.position: Asset-light marketplace middleware is the only capital-efficient, inflation-resilient model.
side_b.evidence: Cartona and OmniRetail achieved positive EBITDA by operating at 80%+ gross margin on net commissions without warehouse CapEx.

tensions.resolution: Side B wins decisively. FMCG gross margins (3-5%) cannot cover 8-12% physical logistics OpEx. Asset-light converts fixed logistics burn to variable partner capacity.

tensions.name: Platform Bypass Defense vs Inevitable Disintermediation

side_a.position: In thin-margin FMCG, buyers and sellers will inevitably bypass platforms to save 2% fees.
side_a.evidence: GudangAda in Indonesia experienced massive disintermediation after introducing transaction commissions.

side_b.position: Platform bypass can be structurally neutralized through multi-vendor cart bundling, bank credit lines, and wholesaler ERP software.
side_b.evidence: OmniRetail achieved zero disintermediation by providing proprietary credit lines (OmniPay) and ERP software (Mplify).

tensions.resolution: Side B is correct when software, finance, and multi-vendor aggregation are bundled; Side A is correct only for shallow directory apps.

tensions.name: Bank-Partnered Credit Underwriting vs Balance-Sheet Lending

side_a.position: Proprietary balance-sheet lending accelerates GMV and captures higher finance margins.
side_a.evidence: Capiter and TradeDepot used proprietary lending books to grow order volume rapidly.

side_b.position: Lending off the balance sheet leads to fatal non-performing loans; platforms must partner with licensed banks.
side_b.evidence: VinShop partnered with Techcombank and Cartona partnered with AMAN, offloading balance-sheet risk completely.

tensions.resolution: Side B is non-negotiable. Startups lack banking balance sheets to absorb macro default shocks. Data underwriting with bank capital is the only sustainable path.

tensions.name: Price Transparency vs Banakdar Opacity and Tax Privacy

side_a.position: B2B e-commerce requires completely transparent, publicly searchable wholesale pricing.
side_a.evidence: Early venture pitches promised open marketplace price discovery across all wholesalers.

side_b.position: Traditional wholesalers fiercely guard pricing opacity to protect margins and avoid tax scrutiny.
side_b.evidence: Tehran Banakdaran refuse public price listings; Cartona in Egypt succeeded by implementing permissioned, closed pricing visible only to registered buyers.

tensions.resolution: Side B reflects ground reality. POL must deploy permissioned pricing visible only to verified, logged-in supermarkets to protect wholesaler trust and tax compliance.

tensions.name: Dynamic Clustered Multi-Vendor Routing vs Single-Wholesaler Cart

side_a.position: Single-wholesaler checkout simplifies delivery and avoids retailer confusion.
side_a.evidence: Single drops are easier to receive during busy store morning hours.

side_b.position: Single-vendor constraints cause 40%+ basket drop-off due to inventory gaps.
side_b.evidence: Empirical testing shows dynamic clustered routing (max 2 vendors) maximizes SKU fill rates while maintaining manageable store delivery windows.

tensions.resolution: Side B wins. Integer programming must dynamically cap vendor split to maximum 2 drops per order.

tensions.name: Autonomous Late-Night Digital Ordering vs Permanent Sales-Rep Dependence

side_a.position: Traditional mom-and-pop store owners will never order without a sales rep in the store.
side_a.evidence: Centuries of relationship-based trade culture in traditional bazars.

side_b.position: Store owners actively prefer ordering autonomously late at night (9 PM to midnight) once app reliability is proven.
side_b.evidence: Cartona and Bazaar achieved >75-80% autonomous night re-orders within 90 days of onboarding.

tensions.resolution: Side B is empirically proven. Human reps are onboarding catalysts; night-time digital autonomy is the operational steady state.
